release.title: Cross-Platform Desktop Support & Full Parity
changes: Native support release for Windows and Linux via Kotlin Multiplatform & Compose Multiplatform.
Full parity across 18 shared screens and 'The Sanctuary' wellness module (Cathartic Writing, Zen Canvas, and Breathing exercises).
Complete SQLCipher migration with strong Room DB hardware encryption (AES-256) and startup crash Recovery Mode.
Dynamic 10-language internationalization with system preference sync and protected local backups (.lifelogs).

release.title: Modularization & Image Storage Pipeline
changes: Modularized project structure into core and widget provider modules.
Implemented local encrypted image storage pipeline for memories.
Updated Room database schema to v14 and refactored background workers.

release.title: Native Security Layer & Integrity Audit
changes: Integrated native security layer for HMAC integrity checks and key hardening.
Automated background memory zeroing upon app pause for maximum privacy.
Added customizable color schemes and expanded i18n support.

release.title: First Stable Release & Core Journal
changes: Launched primary lived-time calculation engine and introspective journal.
Integrated 13 nostalgic color schemes inspired by tribute anime and visual novels.
Automatic 'Operational Life' calculations and secure daily memory logging.

beta.title: Time Capsules & Memory Threads
changes: Introduced Time Capsules to lock journal entries until specific future dates.
Added Memory Threads system, emotion filtering, and capsule arrival notifications.
Password-protected backup export and import flow (.lifelogs).

alpha.title: Multi-Device Alpha Build & SQLCipher Hardening
changes: Verified logic parity across Android, Windows (.msi), and Linux (.deb).
Database schema v14 migration testing and font asset replacement.
Closed alpha testing of local encryption performance on target test devices.
